We are to find **how long it takes to download the entire 200 GB file**.

---

### Step 1: Determine how much of the file is downloaded before the restart

40% of 200 GB is:

$$
0.4 \times 200 = 80 \text{ GB}
$$

So, **80 GB** is downloaded before the restart.

---

### Step 2: Calculate the time taken to download the first 80 GB

At a speed of 2 GB/minute:

$$
\text{Time} = \frac{80 \text{ GB}}{2 \text{ GB/minute}} = 40 \text{ minutes}
$$

---

### Step 3: Account for the 20-minute restart

The restart takes **20 minutes**, so the total time before the restart is:

$$
40 \text{ minutes} + 20 \text{ minutes} = 60 \text{ minutes}
$$

---

$$
200 \text{ GB} - 80 \text{ GB} = 120 \text{ GB}
$$

At 2 GB/minute:

$$
\text{Time} = \frac{120 \text{ GB}}{2 \text{ GB/minute}} = 60 \text{ minutes}
$$

---

### Step 5: Total time to download the file

$$
\text{Total time} = 60 \text{ minutes} + 60 \text{ minutes} = \boxed{120 \text{ minutes}}
$$

---

### ✅ Final Answer:

$$
\boxed{120} \text{ minutes}
